text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Federation forum to continue session on Friday after Moslems and Croats fail to agree on Sarajevo's constitution, federation's flag and coat of arms.
- The government of the Spanish town of Valencia decided to adopt Mostar as its eight district and provide it with one million German Mark budget.

- Bosnia's Serb parliament speaker said non-Serb deputies will not be able to participate in parliament's sessions until they swear the oath saying they will "respect allmighty God, defend Republika Srpska and respect the Bible"
- A Sarajevan was severely wounded when he stepped on a mine in the western Sarajevo's suburb on Thursday.
- Bosnia's collective presidency will discuss forming of the council of ministers on Friday. The deadline for forming this body is October 30.
- The reconstruction of the Sarajevo's oldest hotel Evropa, burned down during the war, due to start in Spring of 1997 and will be sponsored by the Dutch government.
